name: [🔥EVENT🔥] Omega Rune Incremental
desc:
Welcome to Omega Rune Incremental!
In this game your objective is to open Runes that boost your Money and Rebirth and Upgrade your way to the top!

How to play:
💰Collect Money
🍀Open Runes to boost Money
♻️Rebirth to boost your Money even more
🔮Collect Crystals that save on Rebirth
🍀Find Secret and Omega Rarity Runes that save on Rebirth
💎Buy Upgrades and collect Rewards to boost your Luck
🥇Become the richest player and top the leaderboards!
